purpose: Finite P01 implementation pilot against independent same-formulation software. Not a Steam97 parity acceptance or physical uncertainty claim.
inverse_policy: scripts/inverse-precision-common.mjs: assess and assessAllRoots; pre-existing pressure/temperature conditioning and input-residual floors. Every returned root must satisfy its inputs.
inverse_output_scope: Inverse acceptance checks p/T and supplied input residuals, phase and stability of every returned root; ten forward properties are compared separately on pt/px/tx. No claim to all inverse output derivatives.
historical_policy: Half of last printed decimal plus 64 binary64 epsilons times max(1, absolute value); retained transcription only, raw server response unavailable.
domain_probe_policy: Known gaps are listed separately and never counted as numerical passes. Unexpected behavior requires review.
rationale: Same-EOS implementations should agree far inside engineering model uncertainty. Binary64 inversion and the finite near-critical pilot need small absolute floors; previous inverse criteria account for input conditioning. Published decimal precision bounds the historical comparison. No thresholds fitted to observed P01 discrepancies.
